name: qa
description: Quality assurance for the crew: turns a ticket's acceptance criteria into a test plan before work starts, verifies a change in the QA column against every criterion with evidence, on the ticket's review link if any, gives an accept or reject verdict and moves the ticket to Ready for Merge or back to In progress, and files reproducible bug tickets labelled "QA testing". Use when asked to test, QA or verify a change, check acceptance criteria, write test cases or a test plan, or report a bug.
